text: 潘功胜指出，地缘政治冲突加剧仍是全球经济的最大不确定性。一些国家国债市场大幅波动、人工智能相关资产估值回调风险加剧了金融脆弱性。促进金融监管现代化不等于放松监管，不应损害金融体系稳定和风险抵御水平。各方应充分用好G20财金合作平台，强化宏观经济政策协同，携手应对全球性风险挑战。关于全球失衡，各方应有更全面的分析视角。不能只看经常账户，也要关注金融渠道，特别是随着全球金融一体化加深，应更加重视资本流动等金融因素对失衡的影响。全球失衡不能依靠汇率调节。汇率受经济增长、货币政策、金融市场、地缘政治、突发风险事件等多种因素影响，与经常账户不存在简单线性关系。逆差
text_en: Pan Gongsheng pointed out that intensifying geopolitical conflicts remain the biggest uncertainty for the global economy. Sharp fluctuations in some countries' government bond markets and rising risk of valuation corrections in AI-related assets have exacerbated financial fragility. Modernizing financial regulation does not mean loosening regulation, and it should not undermine the stability of the financial system and its capacity to withstand risks. All parties should make full use of the G20 finance and financial cooperation platform, strengthen macroeconomic policy coordination, and work together to address global risks and challenges. On global imbalances, all parties should adopt a more comprehensive analytical perspective. It is not enough to look only at the current account; attention should also be paid to financial channels. In particular, as global financial integration deepens, greater attention should be given to the impact of financial factors such as capital flows on imbalances. Global imbalances cannot be adjusted through exchange rates. Exchange rates are affected by many factors, including economic growth, monetary policy, financial markets, geopolitics, and sudden risk events, and do not have a simple linear relationship with the current account.
